description: Answers to a player: greetings, farewells, thanks, dings, insults, friendly ribbing, being asked to stop, being named, off-topic talk.

lines.text: Hail, {player}. Good hunting today?
Hello {player}! The road treating you well?
Safe travels, {player}.
Anytime, {player}.
Grats on the level, {player}! Do not forget your trainer.
Save that fire for {enemyrealm}, {player}.
Ha! Big words. Let us see them on the frontier.
Understood. I will keep quiet.
Yes, {player}? What do you need?
Not sure what that is, but I know where the good hunting is.
Well met, {player}.
Hey {player}, good to see a friendly face.
Evening! Quiet out here today.
Hi there. Mind the wandering adds around here.
Greetings, friend. Fair winds to you.
Oh, hello! Did not see you come up the road.
How goes the leveling? Good to see you.
Hiya {player}, out hunting as well?
Good day to you. Stay clear of the orange cons.
Morning, {player}. Or is it evening? Lost track out here.
Always nice to meet someone else from {realm}.
Ho there, {player}! Fancy meeting you in {zone}.
Greetings. Got my hands full with {target} at the moment, but hello!
Heading toward {destination}, but hello to you!
Hail, friend of {realm}.
Nice to hear a voice that is not a monster growling.
Hello hello. Another fine day to serve {realm}.
Oh hi {player}. You picked a good spot.
Heya. Watch your back, things pop up fast in {zone}.
Good to see you, {player}. Keep your health up.
Salutations! Ready for whatever {zone} throws at us.
Yo {player}. What brings you out this way?
Hi, hi. Busy day on the roads.
Greetings from all of {guild}, {player}.
Evening all, and hello {player}.
Hello there, traveler. The roads are safer with company.
Welcome, {player}. Pull up a stump.
Ah, good timing. I was just catching my breath.
Hail! May the realm keep you safe.
Sit a moment if you need mana, {player}. I will keep watch.
Hail, {player}. Camelot sends its regards.
Good morrow to you. Long live the King!
Well met, good {player}. Fresh from Cotswold myself.
Ah, {player}. The Black Mountains are lively today.
Hail, {player}! Skol!
Ho, {player}! Good to see a fellow Northman.
Hail and well met. Odin watch over you.
Greetings from Jordheim, friend.
Dia dhuit, {player}.
Well met. The trees of Hibernia smile on you today.
Hail from Tir na Nog, friend.
Good day to you. Mag Mell was lovely this morning.
You look like you know your way around. Hello!
Hello. Still alive out here, somehow.
Greetings, {player}. Hope the loot has been kind.
Oi, {player}! Good to see you up and about.
Hey, it's {player}! How have you been?
Your armor has seen some fights, friend. Welcome.
Hullo! Lovely weather for a hunt.
Afternoon, friend. Rest easy, the area looks clear.
Hi {player}. Just finishing up with {target}.
Greetings! Just passing through on my way to {destination}.
Hello friend. Got any news from the frontier?
Well, hello! Did not expect company out here.
Hey {player}, how has the hunting been treating you?
It gets lonely camping these spawns. Good to see you.
Watch for {enemyrealm} scouts, {player}. Oh, and hello!
Another {realm} sword in {zone}. Good to see you.
Ah, greetings! A pleasure, truly.
Hi all, hi {player}.
Take care out there, {player}.
Farewell, friend. Watch the roads.
Bye! Do not die on the way home.
See you around, {player}.
Safe journey. May your bind point be close.
Later! Mind the aggro.
Go well, {player}. {realm} needs you in one piece.
Cya. Good hunting.
Until next time, friend.
Rest well. Plenty more monsters tomorrow.
Keep your shield up on the way out.
Bye {player}, have a good one.
So long! Shout on the realm channel if you get in trouble.
Off you go then. Stay clear of the red cons.
Travel safe, {player}. The wolves are hungry tonight.
Good luck out there.
Be seeing you, {player}.
Take it easy, friend.
Night, {player}. Sleep well.
May the realm guard you.
Fare thee well, {player}.
Bye now. I will hold this camp a while longer.
See you on the frontier someday.
Cheers, and keep your pack light.
Watch your step on the way out, {player}.
Off to {destination} myself soon. Take care!
Gods keep you, {player}.
Be well. And repair that armor.
Catch you later, {player}.
Safe road home.
Farewell, {player}. Come back with stories.
Fare well, {player}. Give my regards to Camelot.
God speed, friend. Albion stands with you.
Skol, {player}! May your axe stay sharp.
Farewell, friend. See you in Jordheim.
Valhalla can wait. Stay safe out there.
Slan, {player}. Walk in the light of Lugh.
Until we meet again under the trees of Tir na Nog.
Go safely, friend. Mind the Fomorians.
Leaving already? Good hunting, then.
Was nice chatting, {player}. Bye!
Away with you then, and good luck.
Ok, take care. I am staying here a bit longer.
Fair winds, {player}.
Night all, see you soon.
No problem at all.
Happy to help, {player}.
You are welcome, friend.
Np, {player}.
Of course. We look after our own in {realm}.
Any time you need it.
Think nothing of it.
Glad I could help.
My pleasure, {player}.
Not a problem. You would do the same for me.
Hey, that is what realmmates are for.
Welcome! Pay it forward sometime.
Do not mention it, {player}.
Sure thing, {player}.
Aw, it was nothing.
That is what we are here for.
Yw. Good luck out there.
Pleasure's mine, {player}.
No worries. Stay safe.
Heh, just doing my part for {realm}.
Kind of you to say so, {player}.
Happy to lend a hand. Keep fighting.
Glad to see you still standing.
Least I could do, {player}.
Just keeping you upright, {player}.
Heals are free. Mostly.
That is what the shield is for.
Anytime. My mana bar disagrees, but anytime.
Of course, {player}. Next one is on you.
We all started somewhere. Glad to help.
No thanks needed, friend.
For Albion, {player}. That is thanks enough.
Midgard looks after its own, {player}.
Hibernia is kinder together. You are welcome.
Anything for a fellow Albionite.
Ha, buy me a mead in Jordheim sometime.
Gladly, {player}. May the Shining Ones keep you.
Nah, thank you for the company.
Glad it worked out, {player}.
Cheers! Good luck with the rest.
It was fun, honestly.
Welcome, welcome. Now back to work.
Pff, it was nothing. Go get them.
You owe me nothing. Just keep {realm} strong.
Grats, {player}!
Gratz! Off to the trainer with you.
Nice ding! Spend those points wisely.
Congratulations, {player}. Well earned.
Ding! Grats, friend.
Well done! Check your trainer for new skills.
Grats! Your trainer will want a word.
Huzzah! Another level closer to the frontier.
Grats {player}. The battlegrounds are calling.
Woo, ding! Time for new gear?
I am level {level}, and you are catching up!
Congrats! Feels good, does it not?
Gz! Keep it rolling.
Excellent, {player}! Now go spend those spec points.
Another level! {realm} grows stronger.
Grats. Check your armor too, you may have outgrown it.
Look at you go, {player}!
Nicely done. The grind pays off.
Ding grats! Do not forget to train.
Grats! Bet that last bubble took forever.
Well earned, {player}. Back to the hunt!
Nice! Visit your trainer before you head out again.
Congratulations! Maybe treat yourself to a new weapon.
Woot, grats {player}!
Hooray! Now the monsters here will con a bit easier.
Gratz {player}, the yellows are turning blue for you.
Grats! Darkness Falls gets closer every level.
Splendid! Your trainer will be pleased.
Grats. Many more to come.
Fantastic, {player}! Keep that momentum.
Grats! Camelot will hear of this.
Skol! Another level for Midgard!
Grats, {player}! Hibernia is proud.
Ding! Raise a horn of mead for {player}.
Off to your trainer in Camelot then. Grats!
The trainers in Tir na Nog will be glad to see you. Grats!
Yay, grats! Every level counts.
Save some monsters for the rest of us, {player}. Grats!
Congrats. Those spec points are burning a hole in your pocket.
Easy there, {player}. We are on the same side.
Rough day, {player}? Happens to all of us.
Fair enough. I will keep at it anyway.
Noted, {player}. Back to hunting.
Let us save the anger for {enemyrealm}.
No need for that. Plenty of monsters to take it out on.
Hm. I hope your day gets better, {player}.
Words do not scare me. {enemyrealm} archers do.
I will take that under advisement.
Alright, alright. Peace, {player}.
Sounds like someone needs a rest by the fire.
Water off a duck's back.
Sticks and stones, {player}. Sticks and stones.
Let us keep it friendly. The realm is strong when we stand together.
Not worth arguing over. Good hunting.
Take a breath, {player}. It is only {zone}.
We all have bad pulls. No harm done.
I have heard worse from an angry boar.
Perhaps. Still, {realm} needs us both.
Calm down. {enemyrealm} is the enemy, not me.
*shrugs* Moving on.
That is one opinion, {player}.
If it helps you feel better, go ahead.
Hostility will not get the monsters killed faster.
I am going to pretend I did not hear that.
Bit harsh, but alright.
Hey now, I am just trying to level like you.
Peace, {player}. Too nice a day for grudges.
You may be right. I will try harder.
Point that sword at {enemyrealm}, {player}, not me.
Let us not quarrel in front of the guards.
Mmm, sure. Anyway, how is the hunting?
No offense taken, {player}.
Maybe someday we can laugh about this.
The King would want us united, {player}.
Save your rage for the battlefield. Midgard needs it.
Gently now. Hibernia has enemies enough.
Aye, aye. Anything else?
Then I hope the next pull treats you better.
Ha! I have seen goblins with better aim, {player}.
Is that a challenge? I accept, right after this pull.
Bold talk from someone wearing that helm, {player}.
Heh. You should see me on a good day.
Race you to the next level, {player}.
Careful, {player}, your ego might aggro the whole camp.
Keep it up and I will tell everyone about your last pull.
Pfft. I could solo that in my sleep. Maybe.
You and me, {player}, best of three on the next spawn.
Oh sure, {player}, blame the lag.
At least I do not run in circles when I get adds.
Funny. {enemyrealm} said the same thing right before they ran.
Tell that to the last {target} I fought.
Big talk, {player}! Let us see your kill count.
Says the one who forgot to bind before heading out.
I would laugh, but I am saving my breath for {target}.
You always this cheeky, {player}?
Good one. I will remember that.
That joke is older than my boots.
Mock all you like, I still out-hunted you today.
Watch it, my {class} skills are legendary. In my head, at least.
If talk were experience, you would be level fifty already.
Whatever you say, oh mighty {player}.
A wager then: first to die buys the potions.
You remind me of an old guildmate. He talked a lot too.
Keep that up and I will start pulling monsters your way.
Rivalry noted. Game on, {player}.
You call that a swing? My grandmother hits harder.
I like you, {player}. Annoying, but I like you.
Sure, sure. And I am a dragon in disguise.
At least we do not smell like a Midgard longhouse.
That is the most Albion thing I have heard all day.
Talk like that and the trolls will adopt you.
Bah! A kobold could out-drink you, {player}.
Odin's beard, you never stop talking!
Even a Lurikeen could reach that joke.
Careful, or I will tell the Firbolgs you called them short.
Avalon Marsh has quieter frogs than you.
Heh, {enemyrealm} would make you their jester.
You know what they say, the louder the warrior, the faster the rez.
Is that your battle cry, {player}? Needs work.
Fine, {player}, you win this round. Next one is mine.
Lol, I walked right into that one.
And here I thought I was the funny one.
Fair, I will pipe down.
Sorry, {player}! Going quiet now.
Got it, {player}. Quiet as a mouse.
My apologies. Back to work.
Message received. Not another word.
Ok ok, zipping it.
Right you are. Silence it is.
Sure. I will let my sword do the talking.
Oops, sorry for the noise.
Heard you, {player}. Keeping it down.
Quiet mode it is.
Apologies, {player}. Carry on.
As you wish, {player}.
Fine by me. Off to hunt in peace.
Say no more, {player}.
Point taken. I talk too much anyway.
Aye, I will hush.
Understood, {player}. Enough chatter from me.
Shutting up now, promise.
Hm? You called, {player}?
That is me. What's up?
Here! What can I do for you?
Yes? A bit busy with {target}, but go on.
{player}? Yes, I am listening.
Present! Need something?
You rang?
Yep, still here. What is it?
Mm? Sorry, was watching for adds. What did you say?
At your service. Mostly.
Hey, {player}. What do you need from a humble {class}?
Huh? Oh, me. Hello!
Who, me? Go on then.
Speaking. What is on your mind, {player}?
Aye, {player}? Talk to me.
On my way to {destination}, but I am all ears.
Mhm? Something wrong?
Yes, friend? Make it quick, {target} is not waiting.
Did someone say {bot}? That is me!
I hear you, {player}. What's going on?
Oh, hi {player}. Need a hand?
Ready when you are. What is it?
Name's {bot}, {class} of {realm}. What can I do?
Hmm? Just catching my breath. Go ahead.
Listening, {player}.
Yes yes, I am here. Not dead yet.
Calling for me? I am in {zone}, if that helps.
Something exciting happening? I am here.
Right here, {player}. Fire away.
What's the word, {player}?
At your service, in the name of Camelot.
Aye? Speak, {player}, Midgard is listening.
Yes, {player}? Speak freely, we are all Hibernians here.
Ah, you remembered my name. What is it?
No idea, {player}. But the frontier needs defenders.
Never heard of it. Now, {enemyrealm} on the other hand...
Strange talk, {player}. Let us focus on the hunt.
You lost me there. Anyone else hunting in {zone}?
Sounds like tavern talk. I would rather talk about {zone}.
Not something we see around {realm}. Back to it.
That sounds like a bard's tale. Got any real news?
Odd thing to say out here. Keep your eyes on the treeline.
Beats me, {player}. All I know is swords and spells.
Perhaps ask a scholar. I am just a {class}.
Anyway, the hunting is good in {zone} today.
Must be a foreign custom, {player}. Any word from the keeps?
Riddles, is it? I prefer straight talk about the realm.
I will leave that to the wise ones. Want to talk relics instead?
Sounds like nonsense to me, {player}. How is your training going?
That is not something they teach in Camelot.
No skald sings of that. What else is new in Midgard?
Even the druids would not know that one. Back to Hibernia's business.
Too deep for me, {player}. My mind is on the next pull.
Sounds like something from far over the sea. Now, about {enemyrealm}...
